performance.note: coldActiveFunction is the whole-function decompile. phase8InteractiveStage is the canonical-facts stage that runs on every decompile; phase8OptimizeStage is the demand-driven optimizer stage, which only runs when a caller asks for the middle-end facts.

scope: Exact-source Linux CPU performance observation; not full final-platform or device acceptance
remainingFailure: coldActiveFunction median exceeds 250 ms; optimizer passes the owner-authorized 150 ms limit
